name: Far Lands
description: Replicates the 14 iconic Minecraft Far Lands biomes (Skygrid, NetherGrid, EndIsland, Stripe, Strip, Corner, Farther, 64-bit, Vertex, Comb, Pole, Edge Loop, Tunnel, Nothingness) as a worldgen ring around the map border. Coverage is configurable from 0% (disabled) to 100% (entire world) on the Customize World screen, and scales with your world size.
